title: ORRERY — Worlds in motion
description: A responsive, interactive Three.js planetary-system toy with selectable planet profiles, orbit-and-zoom camera controls, pause/resume, speed adjustment, reset, reduced-motion accommodation, and a labeled WebGL fallback. Its visual scale and motion are explicitly illustrative.

tests.outcome: passed; Vite 7.3.6 transformed 7 modules and built successfully with write:false

repairsMade: The initial local bundle check exposed a missing closing parenthesis in the scene veil's CSS gradient; corrected the gradient and removed an empty CSS import, then reran syntax and bundle checks successfully.
Set distinct initial orbital phases and made reset restore those phases so the planets do not begin or reset into a single line.
knownLimitations: Browser/visual interaction checks were not run because browser localhost access is unavailable in this environment.
Planet sizes, distances, orbital rates, and displayed overview values are simplified illustrative choices and not a precision scientific model.
